Hezbollah Rejects Israel-Lebanon Security Deal; Netanyahu Addresses US Ties

Hezbollah has rejected a US-mediated security agreement with Israel aimed at ending hostilities, labeling it a "surrender of sovereignty." The group's stance comes as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed claims of US influence on his leadership, asserting Israel's independent decision-making and focus on its own security interests, particularly concerning Iran. The deal's reception in Lebanon has been divided.
